# fflate 0.8.2

Pinned local UMD distribution of fflate by Arjun Barrett (MIT).

- Package: `fflate@0.8.2`, `umd/index.js`.
- Retrieved from `https://unpkg.com/fflate@0.8.2/umd/index.js`.
- Upstream: `https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate`.
- SHA-256: `c3b34f2e9f5e74d4d7d64e01cac7a0c01954c6c406414d42185c7b53d6875ddf`.
- License SHA-256: `805f6cb28bb8b6d3a0badd83c93bccd9671fa01a3b4b92b7042b0743325ac243`.

The application loads only this local copy, including portable/offline distribution. No runtime CDN is used. ZIP operations belong only to the original-evidence archive, never to financial calculations. The archive validates names, central/local directory consistency, limits and SHA-256 before restoring a single transaction. Evidence format v1 emits and accepts only ZIP STORE entries. Deflate, encryption and ZIP64 are explicitly refused; this avoids trusting a declared expansion size from an untrusted compressed stream.
